question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I can't believe you__ let the cat out of the bag__ about my surprise party!
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"let the cat out of the bag"** means to reveal a secret or disclose something that was intended to be kept **confidential**. (राज़ खोल देना)

 
 
• **Example: **She **let the cat out of the bag** when she mentioned the surprise trip during dinner.
 
 
 
• **"Reveal a secret"** refers to making known something that was intended to be kept hidden. (राज़ खोलना)
 
 
• **Example: **He accidentally **revealed the secret** about the merger during the meeting.
 
 

Therefore, the correct idiom for the given statement to is **Reveal a secret.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ask a question** (प्रश्न पूछना): To inquire or seek information from someone.

 
 
• **Example:** She raised her hand to **ask a question** during the lecture.
 
 
 
• **Keep a secret** (राज़ रखना): To maintain confidentiality and not disclose information.
 
 
• **Example:** He promised to **keep the secret** and not tell anyone about the plan.
 
 
 
• **Make a joke** (मज़ाक करना): To say something humorous or amusing.
 
 
• **Example:** He loves to** make a joke **to lighten the mood during meetings.
